title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S08 E01 — 6-7 Hundred
When a young bus driver approaches the border without any passengers in his coach, officers suspect a smuggling operation may be underway; a man attempts to drive into the U.S. with a van full of goods loaded with more than just clothing.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E02 — I Don't Practice Santeria
With cartels using drones, a newly formed CBP drone strike unit is taking aim at cartel eyes in the sky; an officer suspects that a vehicle may be carrying more than some innocent Santeria sprays.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S08 E04 — Semi-Pro
When a lone driver avoids answering officers' questions, an X-ray reveals dark shadows along her car's floorboard, a sign she could be smuggling narcotics; a semi-pro boxer is detained after being flagged for having a warrant for his arrest.

title: All Access PD: Grand Rapids
description:
S01 E03 — No Excuse
After a shooting, the detectives investigate a victim with a history of domestic complaints; as the victim fights for his life, the female shooter claims self-defense; her attempt to hide evidence raises doubts about her true motive.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S08 E03 — Trifecta of Trouble
A speaker cabinet is found to be carrying more than just sweet beats; a driver who took a wrong turn and ended up at the border crossing is packing more than he should be; following a recent smuggling trend, officers carry out a special operation.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S06 E01 — The Flint-Stoners
Officers examine a trailer filled with cooking supplies and unearth a GPS tracker, the kind cartels use to watch their loads; US citizens who accidentally approach the international border are inspected, and it turns out they have a few secrets.

title: Bering Sea Gold
description:
S17 E03 — Gone With the Wind
The fleet scrambles to get mining before an approaching storm; mechanical difficulties plague Mr. Gold and Kris Kelly; Chris McCully has a close call while diving; Vernon attempts to get back in the gold game.

title: How Booze Built America
description:
S01 E03 — To the Moon!
How alcohol fueled the space race; prohibition; the mystery of who killed John F. Kennedy.

title: How Booze Built America
description:
S01 E01 — America's Revolution
Exploring America's beer and liquor-filled past, including how it ultimately led to the American Revolution.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E03 — Weather Weapons
Are weather control fears fact, or just modern fiction?; Andrew tests theories about chemtrails, cloud seeding, space lasers, and government weather weapons.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E06 — Invisible Weapon of War
Andrew tests a disturbing theory: is a secret, directed-energy weapon used in Venezuela the smoking gun behind unexplained attacks on U.S. government officials overseas?

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E02 — Jersey Drone Panic
When a swarm of craft floods New Jersey's skies, panic erupts online; Andrew digs into every conspiracy theory, interviewing eyewitnesses and testing cutting-edge drone tech, until he uncovers the truth behind the incident.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E04 — The Great COVID Conspiracy
Andrew probes COVID-19's origin from all angles; using intelligence tradecraft, expert interviews, and real-world analysis, he investigates natural spillover, lab-related, and accidental release theories, and what he uncovers is shocking.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E05 — Mysterious Death of Jeffrey Epstein
Andrew investigates what really happened to Jeffrey Epstein; by reconstructing the crime scene using insider insights, expert analysis and a full replica of his jail cell, he tests whether the evidence points to suicide, murder or something darker.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E08 — Secrets of the Drug War
Going deeper while investigating the modern war on drugs, testing theories around the question: if the war is real, why are drug cartels more wealthy and powerful than ever?

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E02 — Big Bang Theories
Reports of loud bangs and bullet holes on the eighth floor spark a tense night before the cause of the chaos is discovered one floor above.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E04 — Nightmare on Fremont Street
A rookie security manager on his first graveyard shift struggles to keep up with an escalating barrage of bizarre calls, ringing one after another; meanwhile, a late-night VIP pickup turns into a cross-town odyssey full of unexpected detours.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E03 — Sex, Lies and Surveillance Tape
A hotel guest reports a theft that launches an investigation with security and Metro detectives, but the truth proves to be far more scandalous.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E05 — Till Death Do Us Shark
Four unique weddings in one day stretch the Golden Nugget's wedding team to their limit; a crack in the 200,000-gallon shark tank raises the alarm; stolen casino keys cause chaos; security breaks up a rowdy wedding party of seniors.

title: Moonshiners
description:
Murder on Thunder Road
Mark, Tim and Josh drive the notorious Thunder Road in Dawson County, Ga.; they investigate the murder of Lightning Lloyd Seay, a notorious bootlegger turned pioneering stock car racer, who was killed over a few bags of sugar.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E01 — Life, Liberty and Tax-free Liquor
Demand spikes for Tim and Tickle's duty-free shine, but big profits breed competition in the Virginia backwoods; Mark and Digger buy 90,000 bushels of surplus corn, but must run stills 24/7 to empty the grain silos in 60 days.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E02 — Stranger Danger
Tim and Tickle's tariff-dodging operation is threatened when a stranger appears at their still site; Mark and Digger face buyer's remorse over their $70K corn purchase; Jerry reaches his breaking point when Mike's $4K moonshine deal goes south.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E03 — Mine and Shine
Josh invests money he doesn't yet have to build a still site that doubles as a gold mine; Mark enlists Amanda and Kelly to distill liquor from surplus soybeans to prove Digger wrong.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E04 — Digger Knows Best
Facing more demand for corn liquor than he can handle, Josh turns to Digger for help. Tim and Tickle discover their oddball neighbor is running an illegal moonshine operation of his own.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E05 — Hillbilly Scotch
Josh's head spins when Jerry reveals his wild plans for their joint moonshine operation. Mark and Digger enlist a Scotsman to help craft the first Hillbilly Scotch.

title: Mysteries of the Deep
description:
S01 E04 — Hunt for Noah's Ark
Jeremy Wade explores how fresh insights into ancient boat building techniques shed new light on the truth behind the biblical story of Noah's flood.

title: Mysteries of the Deep
description:
S01 E07 — Bermuda Triangle Doomsday
Mysterious reports of boiling seas might be evidence of a deadly undersea volcano in the Bermuda Triangle with a long list of victims; Jeremy Wade investigates the newest discoveries from this strange stretch of water.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E06 — Secrets of the Crucifixion
Uncover the true stories surrounding great treasures, long-held conspiracy theories, ancient relics and lost civilizations as experts analyze and investigate history's most astonishing mysteries.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E01 — Terror of Nazi Propaganda
After seizing power in 1933, Adolf Hitler began systematically transforming a peaceful German population into a ruthless war machine; experts investigate the innovative methods used by the Nazis to indoctrinate and control the will of its citizens.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E04 — Secrets of Gobekli Tepe
The ancient site of Göbekli Tepe is the oldest building complex ever discovered and continues to baffle archaeologists; experts investigate new theories behind its construction as a possible commemoration to a cataclysmic event.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E03 — Mary Magdalene Enigma
Mary Magdalene played a pivotal role in early Christianity and witnessed the execution and resurrection of Jesus Christ; experts investigate the truth behind her mysterious disappearance and embark on a quest to locate her undiscovered remains.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E02 — The Devil's Bible
"The Codex Gigas," also known as the "Devil's Bible," is a giant medieval tome that has evoked fear for centuries and is believed to contain a malevolent power; experts investigate its legendary secrets and uncover the mystery behind its author.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E07 — MK-Ultra Revealed
The CIA's MK-Ultra program sought to create mind control methods through unethical human experimentation, and now, experts investigate classified documents that reveal the horrific atrocities that were carried out in the pursuit of national security.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
Village of Lost Souls
The crew investigates reports of vicious paranormal attacks at LA's Heritage Square Museum; as the team explores this collection of Victorian homes, they suspect a dark portal is responsible for shadow figure sightings and poltergeist activity.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
Mentryville Ghost Town
Zak and the crew venture to California's first oil boomtown to investigate reports of ghostly activity inside its buildings and glowing anomalies in the surrounding hills; chaos ensues as the guys attempt to unravel the mystery of Mentryville.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
King Gillette Ranch
The crew visits King Gillette Ranch, a sprawling compound built on sacred land; its dark history plus a brush with a cult has birthed violent spirit activity that drains the living of their energy, making this the GAC's heaviest investigation yet.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
Fear in Flagstaff
Zak and the crew check in for a night of terror at an Arizona hotel where guests and staff have reported troubling paranormal experiences for decades; the chaotic spirit is wreaking havoc, and the GAC may be the only ones who can help.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
Legend of the Snake King, Part 1
Archaeologist Dr. Richard Hansen joins Josh and his team to venture deep into the Guatemalan rainforest to find the hidden tombs of the mysterious Snake Kings in the ancient Mayan city of El Mirador.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
Legend of the Snake King Part 2
Josh concludes his investigation into the mysterious Mayan city of El Mirador, from the possible burial of the elusive Snake Kings to uncovering the secrets behind the fall of one of history's greatest ancient cities.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S06 E05 — Lost Gold of Scotland
Hunting for a lost cache of gold, Josh Gates heads to the Scottish Highlands; his search focuses on a huge gold reserve hidden after the Jacobite Uprising of 1745 and never recovered; Josh joins treasure hunters chasing a lead across the Highlands.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S06 E02 — Deciphering the Last Nazi Code
Josh Gates ventures into the former Third Reich in search of an elusive Nazi fortune hidden with a code allegedly created by Adolf Hitler's private secretary and embedded into a piece of sheet music.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S13 E03 — Traitors' Treasure of 1776
Josh chases the fortune stolen by loyalists to Britain's crown during the American Revolution; investigations of the infamous Doan Gang; Josh helps dig up a cache of plundered coins; a cave search pinpoints the turncoats' hideout.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
Josh's Favorites: The Warrior Queen's Treasure
Searching across England, Josh Gates unearths a cache of ancient treasure as he chases the legend of Queen Boudica, the legendary Celtic queen who nearly defeated the invading Roman army 2,000 years ago.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S31 E33 — Goumond House of Grim
Zak and the crew take a stroll along a street lined with homes from Nevada's past; the team quickly learns that when these houses were moved, the spirits attached to them came along, and now their presence is even stronger.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S31 E05 — Mountain Meadows Massacre
Zak and the crew head to Utah to visit the site of an infamous frontier massacre. Is the centuries-old shame from the senseless slaughter of innocent men, women and children fueling a malicious entity beneath a nearby town?

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S07 E06 — Ghosts of Black Mountain
Remnants of a town in the remote backwoods of Kentucky suggest a forgotten tale of catastrophe and devastation; experts investigate and uncover the history of a deadly industrial mining complex.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S07 E07 — The Doom of El Dorado
The remnants of a settlement in Nevada are interspersed with disintegrating machinery; experts uncover an abandoned mine where dreams of discovering a fortune were met with chaos and murder.

title: Dual Survival
description:
S04 E01 — No End in Sight, Part 1
Stranded in Sri Lanka, Joe and Cody find themselves in a leech-infested jungle.

title: Dual Survival
description:
S04 E02 — No End in Sight, Part 2
Joe faces elephants, and is forced off a cliff; Cody masters an ancient fire piston; the duo crosses a crocodile-infested lake.

title: Dual Survival
description:
S04 E03 — Deadly Dunes
Joe and Cody traverse a desert and venture into the mountains of Oman, showing how nomads have survived for millennia.

title: Expedition X
description:
S10 E07 — Texas Chupacabra
Heather and Phil sniff out the trail of a vampiric Chupacabra said to be terrorizing eastern Texas; joined by a new high-tech hound, can their robot companion help them catch this Badlands bloodsucker in the act?

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E08 — Thunderbird
Recent sightings of a massive bird and reports of missing livestock send Phil and Heather deep into western Pennsylvania. On the hunt for the legendary Thunderbird, they search for proof of the creature that has haunted legends for generations.

title: Expedition X
description:
S08 E08 — The Dogman Conspiracy
The team investigates reports of what some believe is a government conspiracy: the Dogman; this half-wolf, half-man monster is said to stalk the Michigan wilderness, and some even say this creature was created by the US military.

title: Expedition X
description:
S08 E03 — What Lurks in Loch Ness
Phil and Heather investigate a cryptid, the elusive Loch Ness Monster; joined by actor and monster hunter Rhys Darby, they journey deep into the Scottish wilds to explore compelling new evidence beneath Loch Ness' murky waters.

title: Expedition X
description:
S09 E08 — A 'Squatch Above the Rest
Phil and Heather journey into the Kentucky wilderness, searching for sasquatches rumored to be highly intelligent; they quickly find themselves in a chilling game of cat and mouse as the beasts seem always to stay one step ahead of them.

title: Animals on Drugs
description:
S01 E01 — Meth Gators
In a methamphetamine hotspot, drugs seep into local waterways, creating aggressive alligators; wildlife biologist Forrest Galante investigates the effects of meth on these reptiles and attempts to capture and rehabilitate a meth gator.

title: Animals on Drugs
description:
S01 E02 — Drunk Bears
A late-night encounter with a beer-hunting bear sparks a cross-country investigation; wildlife biologist Forrest Galante tracks break-ins and uncovers a strange new trend, bears invading homes to chug booze and devour marijuana edibles.

title: Animals on Drugs
description:
S01 E03 — Cocaine Hippos
Aggressive hippos raised by the cocaine kingpin Pablo Escobar have escaped his abandoned compound in Colombia, becoming a dangerous and deadly invasive species; wildlife biologist Forrest Galante embarks upon a plan to stop them.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E02 — Ice Cold Killer
Traveling from London to Greenland and on to Norway, Wade follows the trail of an unknown sea monster; fishing through ice to extreme depths, he attempts to reel in this monster before the full fury of an Arctic storm hits.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E04 — Return of the Killer Catfish
Jeremy Wade investigates a case in Nepal that sounds strangely familiar -- a lone fisherman dragged off his feet and into a mountain river by the original river monster, the goonch catfish.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E03 — Coral Reef Killer
On the tropical island of Sulawesi, Indonesia, a tourist snorkeler and several local fishermen have been killed and injured by a mysterious sea creature that impales its victims; Wade travels to the scene to investigate.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E05 — Volcanic Island Terror
On a volcanic island in the Pacific, terror grips a fishing community when something in the water leaves a trail of bloody victims in its wake; the only clues they have to the attacker's identity are the large puncture wounds it left behind.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E06 — Malaysian Lake Monster
After two men vanish from a remote lake in Malaysia, Jeremy sets out to find the possible culprit; a trail of evidence leads Jeremy into an ancient rainforest, where an old adversary lies in wait.

title: River Monsters
description:
Killers From the Abyss
Wade takes on the biggest investigation of his career -- to unravel what happened to over 1,000 passengers of the RMS Laconia, torpedoed in the mid-Atlantic; he travels the globe, battling giant fish, massive sharks and a deep-sea monster.

title: Hoffman Family Gold
description:
S01 E01 — The Toddfather Returns
The first family of gold is back with its biggest gamble yet; Todd Hoffman, his father Jack, and son Hunter tackle a gold-rich Alaskan mine deep with ragged equipment and a rookie crew.

title: Hoffman Family Gold
description:
S01 E02 — Todd's Hot Mess
Todd must deliver 300 ounces of gold in just seven weeks; to make it happen, his first step is getting Hot Mess, a massive broken-down wash plant, up and running; Todd goes rogue and opens a new cut behind the mine owner's back.

title: America's Backyard Gold
description:
S01 E01 — Rivers of Easy Gold
Dave Turin shows where everyday miners can find the new gold uncovered in California, talking about a number of ways ranging from picking nuggets out of rivers to metal detecting rare gold worth millions.
